text.en: Over more than fifty years, what people valued changed, and Canada became a more open and more flexible society.
text.fr: Au fil de plus de cinquante ans, les valeurs des gens ont changé, et le Canada est devenu une société plus ouverte et plus souple.

source.quote: As social values changed over more than 50 years, Canada became a more flexible and open society.

verification.evidence: As social values changed over more than 50 years, Canada became a more flexible and open society.

text.en: More places opened up in high schools, colleges and universities, and many Canadians took them up.
text.fr: Il y a eu plus de places dans les écoles secondaires, les collèges et les universités, et beaucoup de Canadiens en ont profité.

source.quote: Many took advantage of expanding secondary and postsecondary educational opportunities

verification.evidence: Many took advantage of expanding secondary and postsecondary educational opportunities and a growing number of women entered the professional work force.

text.en: More and more women began to work in the professions.
text.fr: De plus en plus de femmes se sont mises à exercer des professions.

source.quote: a growing number of women entered the professional work force

verification.evidence: Many took advantage of expanding secondary and postsecondary educational opportunities and a growing number of women entered the professional work force.

text.en: Today, any citizen who is more than 18 years old can vote.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, tout citoyen de plus de 18 ans peut voter.

source.quote: Today every citizen over the age of 18 may vote.

verification.evidence: Aboriginal people were granted the vote in 1960. Today every citizen over the age of 18 may vote.

text.en: People coming to Canada in the 1800s and the 1900s gave the idea of multiculturalism new force.
text.fr: Les personnes venues s'établir au Canada aux XIXe et XXe siècles ont donné une nouvelle force à l'idée du multiculturalisme.

source.quote: The idea of multiculturalism, as a result of 19th- and 20th- century immigration, gained a new impetus.

verification.evidence: The idea of multiculturalism, as a result of 19th- and 20th-century immigration, gained a new impetus.

text.en: By the 1960s, a third of Canadians had roots that were not British and not French. Those Canadians were proud to keep their own culture as part of Canadian life.
text.fr: Dans les années 1960, un tiers des Canadiens avaient des origines qui n'étaient ni britanniques ni françaises. Ces Canadiens étaient fiers de garder leur propre culture au sein de la société canadienne.

source.quote: By the 1960s, one- third of Canadians had origins that were neither British nor French, and took pride in preserving their distinct culture in the Canadian fabric.

verification.evidence: By the 1960s, one-third of Canadians had origins that were neither British nor French, and took pride in preserving their distinct culture in the Canadian fabric.

text.en: Today, the mix of people living in Canada makes life here richer, and this shows most of all in the cities.
text.fr: Aujourd'hui, la diversité de la population rend la vie plus riche au Canada, et cela se voit surtout dans les villes.

source.quote: Today, diversity enriches Canadians’ lives, particularly in our cities.

verification.evidence: Today, diversity enriches Canadians’ lives, particularly in our cities.
